en.frozen_product_page_extraction_machine_s: Frozen product-page extraction · machine scoring, failed calls retained
en.f1_ranges_from_0_to_1_higher_is_better_q: F1 ranges from 0 to 1; higher is better. Quality is shown only for complete verified cohorts. Structured output does not establish correctness. Machine scoring; no independent human review.
en.latency_includes_all_executed_cases_incl: Latency includes all executed cases, including failures, using the current final call per case. Extra retry time is reported in Protocol. Quotes retain plan and usage conditions and are not actual charges.
en.all_pages_and_current_results_are_covere: All {value0} pages and {value1} current results are covered. The original {value2} results were reviewed field by field, with {value3} changed responses audited separately. No unreviewed passes were accepted.
en.the_model_audited_frozen_sources_annotat: The model audited frozen sources, annotations and complete native responses, followed by original-rule adjudication. This is not dual human annotation. Quotations are checked against frozen bytes; literal excerpts are retained separately from original opinions.
en.each_method_still_covers_pages_the_same_: Each method still covers {value0} pages. The same native outputs and official scorer use only source-qualified reference amendments. This post-hoc diagnostic does not replace the original-reference scores on the home page.
en.original_annotations_and_scores_are_reta: Original annotations and scores are retained. These source-qualified amendments are shown alongside the original result in each detail. Empty labels and stock defaults follow the original benchmark rules.
en.these_fields_remain_in_official_scores_a: These fields remain in official scores; audited diagnostics identify source conflicts separately from extractor errors.
en.methods_each_executed_pages_results_stru: {value0} methods each executed {value1} pages: {value2} results, {value3} structured responses. Failure repairs retain successful originals; settings and dates differ, so latency is observational. Quality, end-to-end latency and conditional quotes are separate.
en.original_reference_home_scope: The table below uses the original benchmark annotations. Source-reviewed F1 and reference corrections use the same retained calls.
en.each_field_allows_multiple_accepted_refe: Each field allows multiple accepted reference values but one prediction. Prices use Decimal equality; wrong values add false positives and false negatives, while missing required values add false negatives. The original contract defaults to InStock without clear out-of-stock evidence. Source-qualified reference corrections are retained alongside official scores.

en.fields_were_returned_these_differences_c: A parseable extraction object was returned; fields may be missing or empty. Inspect field differences and source evidence in the same-case detail.

en.original_annotations_follow_an_empty_arr: Original annotations follow. An empty array contains no accepted value; it does not mean the whole case is unannotated. The original benchmark assumes InStock unless clearly out of stock.

en.baseline_stock_projection: The upstream extruct baseline emits a canonical stock indicator but can omit availability. Restore the primary field only when that indicator is unambiguous; retain native responses and original scores.
en.native_product_fields_projection: Scoring reads the declared main-product fields. Reference answers never select a model number, alternate offer or metadata value. InStock and OutOfStock indicators belong to the upstream scoring interface.
en.reviewer_reconciliation: The model findings below are retained separately. Diagnostic scores use the source-adjudicated reference and original benchmark matcher; where the judgments differ, this rule-based result governs the score. The official score remains unchanged.
en.audited_population_scope: Each diagnostic F1 uses the field-specific scored population shown below. Source-ambiguous fields are excluded from these diagnostics; original-reference scores retain the complete population.
en.download_pinned_dataset: Download frozen HTML, original labels and reference corrections (revision {revision})
en.population_stock: Scored: {total} pages; in stock {present}, out of stock {missing}
en.pricing_scope_note: USD per 1,000 calls for this extraction route. Ranges span the stated plans; subscriptions assume full included usage and exclude tax. Trial allocations are not paid unit prices. Usage-based services use workload estimates; see Pricing and access for the calculation.
en.records_notice: Original-reference machine scores · unfinished methods remain visible
en.records_reviewed_notice: All results reviewed field by field · source-qualified scores · failed calls retained
en.records_review_coverage: {reviewed}/{total} results reviewed; {unreviewed} unreviewed results accepted; {unresolved} unresolved findings.
en.records_review_changes: {fields} page-fields have corrected reference text; {groups} site-field groups lack original annotations and are excluded from quality scoring for every method. Native answers and call timings are unchanged.
en.records_review_scope_note: Scores use the source-qualified references. The dataset view retains original annotations and the references used for this comparison.
guide_record_meanings: For each site and field, F1 balances pages that returned a value and pages with at least one matching answer; groups have equal weight. Extra wrong values can still count as a page hit.

Pool every returned and reference value. Extra values reduce precision; missing values reduce recall. Example: one reference, two returned values, one correct gives 50% precision, 100% recall and F1 about 0.667.
Share of scored page-fields whose complete returned value set equals the reference set.
guide_product_meanings: Balances correctly extracted prices against incorrect and missed prices.
Balances correctly extracted SKUs against incorrect and missed SKUs.
Balances the correct stock state against incorrect and missed stock states.
Measures recognition of out-of-stock pages separately from the majority in-stock pages.
en.guide_quality_population: All declared pages; call failures remain in the denominator. Fields without reference coverage are excluded.
guide_latency_meanings: Average final-call time, including failed calls. Prior retry time is reported separately.
Median: half of timed final calls finish within this time.
95% of timed final calls finish within this time.
Cost for 1,000 equivalent calls. Official plan prices and workload-based estimates are labeled separately.
en.guide_time_population: All timed final calls; timed and missing counts are shown.
en.guide_price_population: The selected API, options and stated plan or estimation assumptions.

en.result_no_error: The API did not report an error. The table above shows differences from the reference.
en.case_comparison: Compare outcomes on the same page
en.comparison_baseline_only: Baseline matches; at least one comparison differs
en.comparison_comparison_only: Baseline differs; at least one comparison matches
en.comparison_scope: Correct means all scored fields match, or the selected field matches. Pending and unannotated outcomes do not establish a relation. Activate a relation to show the selected methods on the matching pages.
en.retry_title: Additional time spent on earlier attempts
en.retry_explanation: The home page times the final call. Earlier attempts are counted separately and do not add pages.
en.execution_settings_note: Concurrent collections report latency under the declared load. Isolated latency and throughput have separate execution purposes.
en.worker_resources_scope: These counters cover only the API worker for the final call. Browser subprocesses, Firecrawl backends and remote models are excluded. Observed and missing counts are separate for each metric; absent receipts are never zero. Lower values describe this process only, separately from extraction quality and whole-system efficiency. Methods without worker receipts have no comparable host measurements.

guide_record_meanings: 先按网站和字段计算 F1，再对各组等权平均。每页至少命中一个答案就算命中；多报其他错误值仍可能命中。
汇总所有返回值与参考值。多报会降低准确率，漏报会降低召回率，再用 F1 综合两者。 例如参考 1 个值，返回 2 个且 1 个正确：准确率 50%，召回率 100%，F1 约 0.667。

zh.worker_resources_scope: 这里只统计每条结果最后一次调用的接口提取进程，不包括浏览器子进程、Firecrawl 后端和远程模型。CPU 与内存分别列出有记录和缺失的数量；缺失值不按零计算。低值只说明这个进程的用量较少，与提取质量和整套系统的资源消耗是不同的指标。没有进程记录的方法缺少可比的主机测量。
